name: product-spotlight
title: Product Spotlight
description: An interactive product section that pairs selectable feature descriptions with one matching visual. It accepts a heading and a list of feature items with ids, labels, titles, descriptions, and optional visuals; visitors select an item to update the adjacent explanation. Use it when a product page needs to explain several capabilities in one compact section, rather than stacking unrelated feature cards or showing a static screenshot.
docs: Requires `cn` at `@/lib/utils`. Each feature item needs a stable unique id; provide a useful visual node when the selected feature benefits from a product preview.

meta.engineeringNotes: Uses a data-driven list and caller-supplied visual slot rather than hardcoding product screenshots or feature copy, so the same interaction can explain different products without forking layout code. Native buttons with aria-pressed provide predictable keyboard operation without a custom tab widget or an extra runtime dependency. The selected content is derived from the item id, and an empty collection renders an explicit empty message.
meta.motionNotes: Selection changes content directly without an entrance animation; the visitor needs the new explanation immediately, not a decorative transition. Focus and selected-state styling provide the interaction feedback. No content is hidden behind motion, so reduced-motion preferences require no special behavior.
